description: Update an existing BrewPage HTML, Markdown, code or JSON page. Requires owner token. Returns the updated page metadata. Format omitted keeps the stored format, except a whole HTML document makes a Markdown page an HTML page. The link and delivery mode never change on update; an advisory deliveryModeReason and delivery notice are included when the new content uses browser features that may not work fully on a BrewPage link. Old publications (made before 5 October 2026) are read-only: 409 OLD_PUBLICATION_READ_ONLY with createUrl to publish anew. BrewPage tokens and manage links must never be in public content.

content.description: New HTML, Markdown, code or JSON content

format.description: Content format. Accepts (case-insensitive on html/markdown): 'html', 'markdown'/'md', or a code language — yaml, json, xml, csv, tsv, log, toml, ini, sql, sh, bat, env, javascript, typescript, tsx, jsx, css, properties, docker, txt. Omit to preserve the stored format, except a whole HTML document makes a Markdown page an HTML page.

ownerToken.description: Owner token from create. Default: env BREWPAGE_OWNER_TOKEN (local server only).

state.description: Page data config, same shape as on create. Lists named here are added or updated, the others stay; a stored list keeps its `mode` and `write` when the call omits them. Omitted: the stored config stays; `null` turns page data off (saved entries are kept).

tags.description: Optional tags; replace the page's stored tags ([] clears). Omit to keep them.

name: update_html
title: Update page
